About the Company: Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, MGM, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey.

Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.

Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us! About the Role You'll be the voice of our users inside Product and Design, running both formative research that shapes what we build and validation research that ensures we built it right.

You won't be researching in a vacuum: you'll have direct access to our outbound teams to drive customer conversations, and to our AI implementation teams and Forward Deployed Engineers who live inside customer deployments every day. Few researchers get this close to real enterprise pain points.

Responsibilities Plan and run formative research (discovery interviews, field studies, jobs-to-be-done analysis) that informs product strategy and roadmap decisions Run validation research (usability testing, concept testing, beta feedback loops) to pressure-test designs before and after they ship Partner with outbound and customer-facing teams to recruit participants and drive ongoing customer conversations Mine insights from AI implementation teams and FDEs, turning frontline deployment pain points into actionable UX improvements Synthesize findings into clear, prioritized recommendations that Product and Design can act on immediately Build lightweight, repeatable research practices that scale with the team, including self-serve tools and insight repositories Champion research rigor while moving at startup speed: right-sized methods, fast turnarounds, no research theater Requirement 4–7 years of UX research experience, ideally on B2B/enterprise SaaS or technically complex products Strong command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, and good judgment about which to use when Experience researching with enterprise users and buyers, not just consumers Ability to work independently: you scope your own studies, manage your own pipeline, and drive projects end to end Excellent synthesis and storytelling skills; your readouts change decisions, not just inform them Comfort with ambiguity and technical depth; curiosity about AI and how enterprises adopt it Strong collaboration across Product, Design, Engineering, and go-to-market teams Why This Role Unmatched access : direct lines to customers, outbound teams, and FDEs embedded in Fortune 500 deployments Real influence : research here shapes the roadmap of a category-defining platform, not the margins of it Frontier domain : agentic AI is being defined right now; you'll uncover what enterprises actually need to trust and adopt it Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains.

By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

We're hiring a UX Researcher to work horizontally across Tether's full product portfolio from consumer apps like Keet, QVAC Workbench, and the Tether Wallet, to the developer portals and platforms behind QVAC, Pears, MDK, and WDK.
This isn't a typical UX research role. The breadth is the point: one week you're studying how someone in Lagos uses USDt on their phone, the next you're sitting with engineers to figure out the best practice of developer portals.

We need someone with genuine curiosity, depth of thinking, and the ability to communicate findings clearly enough that product designers and product managers make better decisions because of them. The goal is simple and never changes: the best possible experience for the user.

Run UX research across Tether's consumer and developer products: Keet, QVAC Workbench, Tether Wallet, developer portals, and more
Identify UX best practices and emerging patterns across each product category
Research competitors and adjacent products to surface how others are solving comparable problems, and where the gaps are
Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product designers and product managers
Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to inform decisions at every stage of the product lifecycle
Build and maintain a research repository so insights compound over time and are reusable across teams
Tailor methods to each product qualitative, quantitative, lightweight, deep whatever the question actually needs

5+ years of UX research experience across consumer and/or developer products
End-to-end research chops: defining the question, picking the method, executing, synthesizing, and communicating outcomes
Strong command of qualitative methods (interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry) and working familiarity with quantitative ones
Working knowledge of at least one of: crypto wallets and self-custody, messaging or P2P, AI applications, or developer tooling
Sharp written and verbal communication — able to convert ambiguous findings into decision-ready recommendations
Experience with products where trust, privacy, security, money movement, or technical complexity affect the user experience.
Mandatory AI fluency: you must actively use AI tools to speed up research planning, synthesis, insight mapping, documentation, and reporting, while applying strong human judgement.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to convert messy findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership.
Strong product judgement: able to separate signal from noise and identify which insights should influence the product.
Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where research needs to be practical, focused, and useful.
Genuine curiosity, critical thinking, and depth of analysis that goes beyond surface-level observations.
Low-ego collaboration style, with the ability to challenge assumptions clearly and constructively.
Genuine curiosity and depth of thinking that goes beyond surface-level observations

Background researching developer audiences and developer experience specifically
Experience setting up UX research practices from scratch or scaling them across multiple product teams
Background in fintech, crypto, AI, P2P, or open-source ecosystems
Familiarity with privacy-preserving research methods
Ability to create low-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate and inspire potential user flow , functionality and content structure improvements
Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @
We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.
When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

The purpose of this role is to lead and manage Research and Survey Analytics customer analysis deep dives, execute the strategies outlined by senior leadership, and manage the day-to-day communication with clients. Job Description:
dentsu is seeking an experienced Senior UX Researcher to lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives for a strategic client with whom we have an established relationship and significant opportunity. This is a backfill role on a long-term partnership where you will deepen our research partnership and elevate the quality of our delivery.

You will be the onshore research lead for an engagement operating at the intersection of rigorous methodology, client relationship management, and fast-turnaround insights delivery.
This role requires someone who is equally comfortable designing and moderating complex in-depth interviews, executing quantitative survey research (including statistical analysis), and translating findings into client-ready insights, while maintaining a client partnership that spans frequent touchpoints, competing priorities, and high-stakes presentations.

Study design is typically provided by the client; your differentiation will be in execution excellence, insight depth, and the confidence clients have in your team.

Design and execute in-depth interviews, diary studies, and quantitative surveys across diverse research questions and participant populations
Serve as the primary onshore point of contact for the client, managing expectations, solving problems proactively, and presenting findings with clarity and confidence
Synthesize both qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights, distinguishing between observation, interpretation, and recommendation
Lead or support US-based studies independently while contributing expertise and support to the offshore India research team on larger or complex engagements
Own fieldwork execution, including partnership with the participant recruitment team, moderation, data quality, and timeline management in a fast-paced consulting environment
Maintain the highest standards of research rigor and client communication; your work directly influences renewal decisions and account growth
Collaborate with quant research partners when studies require data analysis or statistics (e.g. MaxDiff / TURF / Conjoint)
Manage ambiguity and navigate client relationships with calm, problem-solving orientation, especially when competing priorities or unclear direction arise
Required Experience and Skills
Minimum 5–7 years of professional UX or market research experience
Demonstrable expertise in conducting in-depth interviews (IDIs) and diary studies across multiple research contexts; evidence of extensive fieldwork
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing quantitative survey research, including exposure to statistical methods and either / both R / Python
Strong synthesis and analytical skills: ability to identify patterns, surface surprising insights, and distinguish between data, interpretation, and speculation
Excellent written communication; ability to produce polished, research-defensible insight documents and client presentations
Proven client-facing skills: you can present findings with confidence, handle pushback with grace, and maintain professional composure under pressure
Comfort working independently on projects while also supporting larger team efforts; ability to balance autonomy with close collaboration
Experience moderating research with diverse populations and the ability to adapt your approach to different participant contexts
Ability to work in a consulting environment: fast timelines, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs are normal

Experience working with technology companies or in consumer tech research
Familiarity with research platforms such as dscout, Qualtrics, SPSS, or similar tools
Background in behavioral economics, user psychology, or related frameworks
Experience working with distributed or offshore research teams
Exposure to competitive intelligence or market research methodologies

s.h: What We're Looking For (Beyond the Resume)
s.t:
A researcher who thinks about the client relationship as part of the research itself, you understand that how you present and communicate findings shapes whether the client will act on them
Someone who is energized by working under ambiguity and can help clients clarify what they actually need to know
A collaborator who is happy to chip in where needed on team projects but also thrives owning your own studies from design through delivery
A person who cares deeply about research rigor and can explain why methodological choices matter in plain language to researchers and non-researchers alike
Someone who stays calm when clients are frustrated, stressed, or changing direction mid-project, and who can see the research problem underneath the emotion
At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams.

Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time.

Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office.

You develop research strategies for complex product questions.
You select the right qualitative and quantitative research methods.

You connect product data with qualitative and quantitative research insights.
When evidence improves a product decision, the impact of your work is visible.

Several years or more of UX Research experience with a quantitative focus.

You understand complex study designs and data triangulation.

You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.
Nice-to-have
Experience with survey design, sampling, scaling, and questionnaire design.

Match is hiring a mixed methods User Researcher (UXR) to drive research efforts across the dating and social connections space. In this position, you will partner with leadership, product managers, and designers using a variety of quantitative and qualitative research methods to identify new opportunities to improve the dating journey, validate product solutions, and help us understand the "why" behind the trends we see within our analytics data.
Affinity is a division of Match Group that is home to online dating apps like BLK, Chispa, and Upward where singles can connect based on what they have in common. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
This is a six-month temporary position with the option to work remotely.

Conduct research initiatives that drive our brands towards making dating enjoyable and rewarding for singles, using rigorous qualitative and quantitative research methods.
Foster a deep understanding of a variety of user segments for our Affinity apps in general.
Generate actionable insights to drive stakeholder decision making for a range of initiatives, including innovative new bets.
Communicate insights in compelling ways; bridge alignment across teams through written reports and in-person presentations.
Partner with Design and Product to make research an essential part of our practice and culture (i.e., creating documentation on best practices, advocacy of methods, partnering and mentoring on tests run by design or PMs).

s.h: You'll love it here if you are
s.t:
Excited to play a key role in improving dating for a number of different user segments with unique needs.
Empathetic and curious — able to investigate complex and very human problems with minimal bias and ego
Have a strong analytical orientation and curiosity about research and its implications
Creative and flexible in your approach to answering questions
Passionate about conducting mixed methods research to create a more complete picture of the problem space

s.h: We could be a Match if you have
s.t:
At least 1+ years of experience conducting user research in a product environment (B2C or B2B)
Experience conducting user interviews and usability testing (moderated and/or unmoderated).
Experience creating surveys and analyzing the results to determine user attitudes and behaviors
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to share research to all audiences from designers to executive level stakeholders.
Comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment

Change the way the world travels
Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it-s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.
Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
Team mission
UX Research at GetYourGuide is responsible for understanding all the users we serve, the problems we solve for them, and maximizing their trust, so that decisions across product, design, and business are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions. The team combines hands-on research with the systems, tools, and processes that enable researchers and cross-functional partners to move faster and act on insights with confidence.
Within the Product and UX organisation, the Research Programs & Operations function owns the infrastructure behind that work: knowledge management, recruitment, tooling, and governance. This role will sit at the center of that function, building the programs and AI-assisted workflows that let the wider research practice scale without sacrificing quality.

* Design and maintain the systems, tools, and programs that help researchers and cross-functional partners turn evidence into decisions at scale, covering knowledge management, recruitment, self-serve research, tooling, and governance.
* Spot and build AI-powered workflows that speed up the research and design process, from intake and participant recruitment through synthesis, rollout and activation.
* You work confidently with senior stakeholders on feasibility and trade-offs, turning research into decision-ready outputs, not open-ended discussion. Builds sticky artifacts (concept visuals, posters, prototypes, one-pagers) that make ideas land.
* Help run team meetings, discovery workshops or related forums that surface operational gaps early, size up resourcing needs, and inform the team's roadmap.
* Advise stakeholders on the appropriate processes or tools for their specific problem and help new teams adopt these systems, e.g., by organizing training sessions.
* Take ownership of ongoing research tool screening, vendor onboarding, security assessment, negotiations, access management and org-wide trainings.
* Work across product, design, marketing, and business teams to shape the end-to-end customer experience, help and track the research team, tying findings back to business outcomes and KPIs.
What you need to be successful
* 5+ years of experience in UX Research, UX Strategy, or UX Program Management in a tech organization, including exposure to research-specific operations.
* A track record of building research systems and user panels that hold up at scale without compromising quality.
* Refined operational know-how across qualitative incl. unmoderated interviews and quantitative research methods and choosing the right level of rigor for the situation.
* A history of shifting major program-related decisions at the senior stakeholder level, through communication program innovation, not just reporting findings.
* Skill in independently visualizing direction-through sketches, prototypes, service blueprints, or AI-assisted outputs-paired with a clear, hands-on point of view on how AI should reshape research workflows.
* Familiarity with research ethics, accessibility frameworks, customer relationship (CRM), consent (NDAs), and related policies (GDPR, e-privacy, DSA, WCAG, etc.)
* Solid business judgment (b2c, ideally also b2b), able to tie research to trade-offs and commercial impact.
* Sound experience in vendor management, budget tracking and negotiations.
* Concise level-specific communicator.
Extras that give you an edge
* Experience designing or facilitating cross-functional communication programs and events at scale.
* A sound understanding of the current research vendor and tooling landscape, a track record of negotiation wins and success in tool migrations across functions.
* Background in building or deploying AI agents for operational use cases (e.g., recruitment pipelines, repository and synthesis tools).
How we-ll make your career journey extraordinary
* Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
* Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
* A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
* Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
* Monthly transportation and fitness budget
* Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
* Language reimbursement program

⭐️ The User Researcher role ⭐️
At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.
As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.
